title.zh: 释放集群实例的直连地址

descriptions.zh: 客户端可通过直连地址绕过代理，像连接原生Redis集群一样连接云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群，从而降低链路开销，进一步提升实例的响应速度。更多信息，请参见[开通直连访问](~~146901~~)。
descriptions.en: In direct connection mode, clients can bypass proxy nodes and use private endpoints to connect to ApsaraDB for Redis instances. This is similar to the connection to a native Redis cluster. The direct connection mode can reduce communication overheads and the response time of ApsaraDB for Redis. For more information, see [Enable the direct connection mode](~~146901~~).
